**Verdict: request changes** — one real regression in the new receipt-scan flow's stale-response guard, plus a duplicate-name data-integrity bug in the partial-failure retry path, and no component-level test coverage for the new client-side logic.

- [high] `src/features/scan/AddProductFlow.tsx:106-122,160-162` — `readReceipt` relies on the `latestRequest` ref to discard a stale response once the user has moved on (`if (request !== latestRequest.current) return;`), exactly like the pre-existing "Enter manually" handler at line 289 which explicitly does `latestRequest.current++` before navigating away. But the new `rescan` (line 160) and `goManual` (line 162) handlers — both reachable from the `receipt_capture` card while a receipt read is in flight (`busy={readingReceipt}` only disables the `PhotoCapture` submit button, not the sibling "Scan barcode"/"Add manually" buttons) — never bump `latestRequest.current`. If a user taps "Scan barcode" or "Add manually" while their receipt photo is still being read, the in-flight request is not invalidated; when it later resolves (success or error), `readReceipt`'s guard passes and it silently calls `setStep`, yanking the user back to `receipt_review`/`receipt_capture` and discarding whatever they'd started on the barcode/manual screen.

- [medium] `src/features/scan/ReceiptReview.tsx:73` — on partial save failure, rows are filtered back into view with `rs.filter((r) => failedNames.includes(r.name.trim()))`. If two rows share the same trimmed name (common on receipts — e.g. two separate "Banana" lines) and only one of them fails to save, both rows are kept for "retry" even though one was already added to the pantry. Re-submitting then creates a duplicate pantry item for the one that already succeeded. Matching needs to be done by row id, not by name.

- [medium] No test coverage was added for `ReceiptReview.tsx` or the new `readReceipt`/`saveReceiptItems` logic in `AddProductFlow.tsx` (`git diff --stat` shows only `src/server/vision/receipt.test.ts` as new tests). This is non-trivial client logic — partial-failure handling, row removal, quantity parsing/validation — and the two bugs above are exactly the kind a component test would have caught.

- [low] `src/features/scan/AddProductFlow.tsx:135-155` (`saveReceiptItems`) — items are saved with a sequential `for...of` + `await pantryApi.create(...)`, one POST round-trip per line. A long receipt (the UI explicitly supports up to 3 photos "for a long one") will serialize N network round-trips before the user sees "Add N items" complete.
